module: Editor "Level Validator" tool (Window > Debug menu). The "Find issues" button starts a job that searches the level for duplicated objects, floating objects (not planted on the terrain), misconfigured splines (fewer than 2 nodes) and zero or near-zero scales, for scene objects and forest items. The results are sortable, ignorable, and some are fixable (deleting duplicates, no undo possible). The results can be read by other modules via getLevelLogs.
notes: Preference levelValidator.general.extendedLogs: displays additional errors in the list.

In startLevelValidation, getLevelLogs() is called but this local function is defined further down in the file (line ~894): at that point the global getLevelLogs is targeted, hence nil. With extendedLogs enabled, the call fails (probable game bug).
Log levels: I, W, E, D. Internal types: duplicate, floating, spline, scale.
onEditorAfterSaveLevel is empty (the automatic call to startLevelValidation is commented out).

startLevelValidation.desc: Starts the level validation in a job (core_jobsystem, period 0.04) and sets the state to "search in progress".

getLevelLogs.desc: Returns the raw list of issues found (entries with logLevel, type, objectId, message...).

getLevelLogsAggregated.desc: Returns the issues grouped by readable type (Duplicated Object, Floating Object, Spline Misconfigured, Duplicated Forest Item, Floating Forest Item, and "Zero or Near-Zero Scale"). Each entry is enriched with the object's name and position, and a camera position/rotation (15 m behind the object).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the "levelValidator" window and the "Level Validator" menu entry (Debug group).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: writes a Debug log "initialized".

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the tool window (Find issues button, filterable and sortable list, actions).

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Registers the levelValidator.general preferences category (extendedLogs, hidden columnSizes).

onClientStartMission.desc: Called when a level starts: resets the terrain dimensions, the logs and the check state.

onEditorAfterSaveLevel.desc: Called after the level is saved. Empty body.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: If extendedLogs changes, clears the results and resets the check state.

sortingFunctions.desc: Sort comparators for the result list columns (a and b are two log entries).

Origin.desc: Sort by origin field (empty string if absent).

ObjectName.desc: Sort by the name of object a.object (empty string if absent).

Line.desc: Sort by lineNumber field (0 if absent).
